definitions.full: H4184. mush II. [ מוּשׁ ] verb feel (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic , מוּשׁ id. ; secondary form of משׁשׁ q. v.); — Qal Imperfect 1singular suffix וַאֲֻמשְׁךָ Gen 27:21 draw near that I may feel thee. Hiph`il Imperfect 3masculine plural יְדֵיהֶם יִמִישׁוּן וְלֹא Psa 115:7 as for their hands, they do not feel (of idols; || יְהַלּ֑בוּ וְלֹא דַגְלֵיהֶם ); Imperative suffix וַהֲמִישֵׁנִי Judg 16:26 Qr (Kt והימשׁני , see ימשׁ ), but read וַהֲּמִשֵּׁנִי , see משׁשׁ . מוֺשָׁב see ישׁב .
